options.content: Raw device diagnostics, not period energy or billing meters. Hybrid inverter AC output includes possible battery output and is not pure PV production. Grid meter location must be the unique validated interconnection; never add duplicate meter counters. Battery current is **positive charging**, opposite powerflow P_Akku. Capacity API units are unverified; no Ah/kWh inference. Optional AC day/year counters may be unavailable. Neutral colors are not manufacturer limits.
